_about: Copy to ops/machine.json on a machine that is NOT the PC the highway was written for. No file means: that PC; everything applies and the highway repairs. See covenant_highway.machine_profile.
_own_nodes: Optional (A465). The node(s) THIS machine hosts, as id: a port on 127.0.0.1 where that node's /health answers. Only a port: the highway asks this machine and nowhere else. Leave the key out and the mesh checks read not known here.
why: this PC hosts node D only; its services are kept running by its own watchdog

not_applicable.node_down: asks this machine for nodes A, B and C, which run on the other PC
not_applicable.sync_task_missing: expects the other PC's scheduled tasks
not_applicable.model_unmanaged: this PC's model servers are started by its own start script, not by the keeper
not_applicable.redundancy_degraded: looks for the other PC's beacons
not_applicable.build_stale_on_pc: the app build is fetched on the other PC
not_applicable.manifest_stale: the bundle is sealed on the other PC
